cards.why: Dale was laid off on 14 August and his coverage ended 31 August: a termination that caused a loss of coverage. Brindlemoor is employer and administrator and counts from the loss of coverage, so the notice is due by 14 October 2026 (31 August plus 44 days) (2590.606-4(b)(2)). It is one notice to Dale and Rina at 41 Alder Court
Mireille resigned on 28 August and her coverage ended 31 August; the reason for a termination does not matter, so a quit has COBRA (54.4980B-4 Q&A-2). Due by 14 October 2026
Gerald died on 3 September and Ilse's coverage ended 30 September: a death that caused a loss of coverage. Due by 13 November 2026; her maximum period is 36 months

Anselm's hours fell to 24 on 1 September, under the plan's 30, and his coverage ended 30 September: a reduction of hours that caused a loss of coverage. Due by 13 November 2026 (30 September plus 44 days)

Delphine is Anselm's spouse, but the plan has her at a different address (Pinecrest Lane, Millbrook; they live apart), so a notice to Anselm does not serve her (2590.606-4(e)(1)); she is owed her own, at her address, by 13 November 2026

Cass's divorce was final on 20 July, her coverage ended 31 July and his letter reached HR on 28 September, inside 60 days of the latest of the dates (29 September). The administrator has 14 days from receiving it (2590.606-4(b)(1)): due by 12 October 2026, not 44 days from the divorce

Wren turned 26 on 12 August and her coverage ended 31 August; Hollis's written notice reached HR on 30 September, inside 60 days. The administrator has 14 days from receiving it: due by 14 October 2026, at her own address in Coldwater
